name: 57-settings-duplicate-checked
description: Rule: settings screens are checked before they are dropped (duplicate id, cells), so an old file fails the same way it always did.
input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: wifi
    app: home
    widgets:
      - {type: clock}
  - id: wifi
    app: settings
    widgets:
      - {type: wifi, cs: 4, rs: 2}
